name: Figma
description: Bundled Framelink Figma MCP: layout and styles via FIGMA_API_KEY in .env — ships in prebuilt release (no registry fetch).

setupSteps.title: Create a Figma token
setupSteps.instructions: In Figma: Settings → Security → Personal access tokens. Copy the token (starts with figd_).

setupSteps.title: Add to project .env
setupSteps.instructions: At the workspace root (same folder as vodou-core), set FIGMA_API_KEY=figd_… in .env. Restart the worker/gateway after saving so the MCP process inherits the variable.
setupSteps.gotcha: Do not paste the token into the preset JSON. Vodou only reads the env name FIGMA_API_KEY from your environment.

setupSteps.title: Add server
setupSteps.instructions: Click Add server. Vodou runs the bundled Framelink server: node MCP-servers/figma-developer-mcp/node_modules/figma-developer-mcp/dist/bin.js --stdio (paths relative to the project root). Prebuilt installs include node_modules; from git run cd MCP-servers/figma-developer-mcp && npm ci --omit=dev once.

setupSteps.title: Use in chat
setupSteps.instructions: Paste a Figma file or frame URL in your prompt. Tools fetch simplified layout and styling for implementation.

setupSteps.title: Version pin in repo
setupSteps.instructions: The wrapper under MCP-servers/figma-developer-mcp pins figma-developer-mcp in package.json / package-lock.json. Release builds run npm install --production there when staging the archive.
